scenes.description: An adult seated and slightly hunched forward with both hands over the stomach, face showing a sharp gripping stomachache. A plain comfortable indoor setting, no medical equipment or injury detail.
A hand-cranked mill has visible rough grinding surfaces, with grain passing between them and crushed material collecting in a bowl.
Two hands turn a short wooden toggle through a cord wrapped around a small bundle of logs.
A plain wooden top spins upright on a table, with a blurred edge and tight circular motion trails.
